title: Google DeepMind to Open Robotics Lab in Boston Area
key_facts: Google DeepMind is building a new robotics lab in Cambridge, near Boston, for a hardware team focused on bringing advanced AI into physical systems.

Aaron Saunders, Google DeepMind vice president of embodied systems and robotics and former Boston Dynamics chief technology officer, announced it in a LinkedIn recruitment post on Monday (12 Oct 2026).
Saunders said the team has been under development since he joined almost a year ago and will be housed in the new facility.
He is looking for machinists, engineers and researchers 'to bring the benefits of AGI into the physical world'.
Saunders joined Google DeepMind in November 2025 after more than two decades at Boston Dynamics, where he became chief technology officer in 2021.
